history.body: Hi, my partner and I saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re looking for a home with space for a home office. Could you tell me more?

Thanks — Pearl Residences has a 900 sq ft layout with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, so one of the bedrooms could potentially give you a dedicated work-from-home space. The living, dining and kitchen are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor to make better use of the space. Whether a bedroom suits your desk and storage setup would need to be checked against the approved plan. Are you looking for a fully dedicated office room, or mainly a comfortable spot for a desk?
A comfortable desk spot would probably be enough, since we could share the room. Could you send the approved floor plan and price range so we can check the space and budget?

A shared room with a comfortable desk sounds like a practical option to explore in the three-bedroom layout, though the approved plan is needed to judge the usable space. The pricing reference shows indicative base prices of about RM328k–RM358k, depending on unit category and floor, before any applicable car-park or package adjustments. The current exact price and package need confirmation, so that isn’t a confirmed all-in range.
